remainingRisks: Native WGSL/pipeline interfaces and GPU execution remain unverified in this environment.
Disjoint partitions change collisions/replacement; hot partitions can increase direct analytical bypass work.
Deferring diagnostic compilation moves optional work off first UI, but does not remove total work or guarantee faster end-to-end startup.
GPU timestamp queries, HUD drawing, queue backpressure, compositor timing and cache occupancy still need target-device measurements.
